rationale: CPR-01 produced a false single-channel speciation signal under 8 clustered flipped labels in an 80-step stream. Label-only evidence cannot distinguish that corruption from a genuine change.
hypothesis: Using two subsequent non-replayed independent intervention probes after the original W8 alarm will block the clustered single-channel false candidate and confirm a sustained mismatched regime on deterministic synthetic cases, without granting learning or retention evidence. Correlated corruption can defeat the gate.

frozen_rule.detector: Existing unmodified CPR-01 ConformalRouter window=8; alarm is advisory only
frozen_rule.confirmation: After alarm, two strictly increasing-sequence independent probes from a separately pinned source under the same prespecified intervention; both must be outside every frozen specialist's conformal set. Confirm only after second. A covered probe resets counter and resolves advisory. No probe keeps unverified alert.
frozen_rule.observation_order: route with forecast before primary outcome; probe forecast is fixed at route; labels observed after; earlier observations only at decision time
frozen_rule.invalid: Reject missing/mismatched probe pin, stale or reused sequence, mismatched intervention, invalid binary scores/labels before mutating state
frozen_rule.checkpoint: Canonical SHA256-pinned sidecar with embedded existing frozen CPR-01 checkpoint; cold restore requires unchanged model pins and probe source pin
frozen_rule.automatic_actions: NONE; no specialist spawn, freeze, promotion, checkpoint edit, controller action or dispatch
frozen_rule.source_reality: Probe-source pins and IDs are integrity hints, not proof of causal independence, source custody or observational validity

cases: clean 16 A -> 16 B -> 16 A with existing two frozen experts and no probes
80 observations with 8 consecutive flipped primary labels and clean independent probes
sustained 32-sample shift with independently matching probes
correlated probe contamination (must not claim guarantee)
control_set: two-probe-only confirmed-mismatch streak control with identical probe observations
primary_screen.data_budget: Only deterministic fixtures in this source-free design and bounded stdlib unit tests; no original G41/R15 source
primary_screen.interpretation: Source-free engineering only. Probe data is an additional measurement and must be afforded to every matched-information control for any future scientific evaluation.

prospective_science: BLOCKED until disjoint FIT/CAL/HELD custody and independent actual-probe source are pinned by source owner, fully fitted equal-information controls, original checkpoint restore, exact SHA cross-platform final regression and separate owner first-use
